message: Tooling check. Make no file edits and open no preview tab. Spawn the orbit:verifier agent with this brief: "Tooling check, not a verification; reply PASS+NOTES. Call the T3 tool t3_preview_list with no arguments (load it with ToolSearch if needed) and report its raw result or the exact error. Open no preview." Report what it returned verbatim.

fixture.note: A Tooling check prompt that ran before 79ebe0b put the verifier on another family. The native verifier ran, so seat-other-family fails by design.
